name: skillnav
title_zh: 先问一句这技能值不值得装，再决定装哪个
tagline_zh: 面对一堆技能拿不准装哪个？它先替你做价值判断，再在大目录里挑出能用的那个，执行完把结果摆给你看。可选范围偏好。
tagline_en: Unsure which skill to install? It first judges if one adds value, then finds a workable pick from a large or.
desc_en: Explicitly use SkillNav to decide whether a skill adds value, find suitable skills in a large or incomplete catalog, execute the eligible choice, and show checked results. Optional scoped preferences and recommendation-only mode.
why_zh: 别的目录只负责陈列，它负责裁决：先问这技能是否值得，再执行并展示核验结果。
why_en: Other catalogs just list; this one judges first, then executes and shows verified results. It welds choosing and doing into one.
limit_zh: 它不装技能本身，只做挑选与执行调度。若候选技能缺依赖或需交互式输入，它会停下询问而非替你硬跑。
limit_en: It doesn't install skills—only selects and orchestrates. If a candidate lacks dependencies or needs interactive input, it stops to ask rather than.
title_en: Ask if a skill's worth it, then pick the right one
